title: Shepherd Moons
notes:
Brazilian variant, probably first Brazilian pressing from 1991 (due to "Book Of Days" being sung in Irish Gaelic).
Warner Bros. Records and Reprise Records logos are printed on the disc label.
Disc label is white and have black fonts.
There is no Mastering SID Code and no Mould SID Code.
There is no Barcode on the sleeve, expect for a barcode with thick lines on the Matrix/Runout.

Songs on the disc have the following respective phonographic codes:
01) 64406806
02) 64406814
03) 64406822
04) 64406830
05) 64406849
06) 64406857
07) 64406865
08) 64406873
09) 64406881
10) 64406890
11) 64406903
12) 64406911

"Fabricado pela MICROSERVICE - Microfilmagens e Reproduções Técnicas Ltda, CGC 43 359 926/0001-80 - São Paulo."

This edition has the "Book Of Days" sung in Irish Gaelic, making the original recording relatively rare.
From mid-1992 onwards, the subsequent releases of this album had this song swapped for the English version.
